mapper.sql: o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, o.series_id AS seriesId, o.series_title_snapshot AS seriesTitle, o.price_cents AS priceCents, o.currency, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.provider_trade_no AS providerTradeNo, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.fulfilled_at AS fulfilledAt, o.closed_at AS closedAt, o.fulfillment_attempts AS fulfillmentAttempts, o.last_error AS lastError, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.updated_at AS updatedAt

where.if: AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.series_title_snapshot LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_order o JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order o JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
SELECT FROM t_order o JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT FROM t_order o JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'REFUND_FAILED') OR (o.status = 'PAYING' AND o.updated_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR o.last_error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'REFUND_FAILED') OR (o.status = 'PAYING' AND o.updated_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR o.last_error IS NOT NULL
